# Parity Obligations — generated by tools/abi/parity_obligations.py

DSOs (system libxml2 2.15.3 / libxslt 1.1.45 / libexslt 0.8.25) a

handwritten; an entry earns PARITY_VERIFIED only through passing per-symbol
courts (atlas/SYMBOL_COURT_INDEX.json).
